WorldLoopWork.responsibility: one bounded LivingWork slice; offers current-source C review opportunities
WorldLoopWork.boundary: no independent loop or final judgment

ConcernService.responsibility: indexed source-backed concern lifecycle and C event proposal
ConcernService.boundary: does not adopt final goals or own execution authority

CognitionSession.responsibility: frozen request/reply correlation and proposal persistence
CognitionSession.boundary: no Subject/Kernel handle in provider DTO; no final judgment

WorldModel.responsibility: sourced temporal belief revisions and rebuildable projections
WorldModel.boundary: beliefs are not self-certified truth; values use original RecordService

EpisodeLearning.responsibility: independent checked episode, atomic strategy fence
EpisodeLearning.boundary: no goals, desire, external action or new learning loop

SelfExtensionWork.boundary: holds trusted application review handle; cannot mint Kernel Grant

OpenAgencyService.responsibility: mechanically commits C-endorsed candidate/adoption/one approved step
OpenAgencyService.boundary: not independent will; Manager/Grant/Budget/Verify still apply

NanaRuntime.responsibility: single scheduler, wake, owner epoch and safe work opportunity
NanaRuntime.boundary: WHEN only; no second WHAT/WHY loop

authoritative_store: original ContinuityStore; four new indexed headers, existing erasable payloads
fixture_world_json: synthetic external environment/effect state, not Subject state
test_fixture_stores: main/contrast are independent experiments, each one Subject/Store
